title: A calendar of the sky events you choose
description: A saved event is tied to the observing place and to updates of its card.

blocks.text: Interest often arises around one comet or one other event. A large catalog does not help if the entry you need is hard to find.

quote.text: Bought the comet pack to help find Tsuchinshan-ATLAS and it’s not listed.

blocks.text: Gather the search, the preparation and the reminder around a single object. Show when it was updated and how the observing conditions have changed.
Editorial upkeep matters more than the number of cards. A saved plan that has gone stale should look clearly different from one that has been updated.
